description: Public Microsoft installer media the demo stages on lab VMs, pinned by size and SHA-256 (nothing here is secret). Stage-DemoMedia.ps1 verifies both before an ISO is moved into place and records your terms acceptance privately in .local\media-acceptance.json. If Microsoft refreshes a file the pin fails closed: confirm the new file from the licence/download page, update bytes and sha256 here, and accept the terms again.
